recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of four men in 1980s rock attire (leather, denim, western shirts) against a dark, near-black background. The composition is framed by a thin red border, with bold, blocky typography anchored by blue horizontal bars at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject depth created by staggered positioning of the four men
Contrast between the dark background and the vibrant red/blue graphic elements
Textual framing using horizontal blue bars to contain the display type
Direct, moody eye contact from the subjects to the viewer
coreInvariants: Primary red and blue graphic accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four men arranged in a staggered formation; the figure on the left is most prominent in the foreground, while others recede into the shadows.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central band name at the top, emphasized by blue bars.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, moves down through the faces of the subjects in a diagonal zig-zag, ending at the bottom subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark negative space surrounding the subjects, focusing attention on their faces and clothing textures.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast lighting on skin tones and clothing textures against a flat, dark void.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with industrial, blocky proportions
characterSpecificRedesigns: Flat tops and bottoms on curved characters like 'O' and 'R'
Tight kerning to create a solid wall of text

composition.relationshipToImage: Layered over the dark background, framed by blue bars

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniformity; the top and bottom text use the same typeface at different scales.
graphicDevices: Horizontal blue bars above and below text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, industrial slab serif aesthetic
Provides the necessary geometric slab weight

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of four men in 80s rock fashion (leather jackets, denim, western shirts) against a black background. Use low-key lighting to emphasize facial features and clothing texture. Add a thin red border around the entire frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two horizontal blue bars at the top and bottom. Center bold, red, condensed slab-serif text between the bars at the top and smaller matching text at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the border a consistent thin red line?
Are the blue bars perfectly horizontal and centered?
Is the text a heavy slab serif in red?
Is the lighting on the subjects moody and directional?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the portrait
Specific clothing items (e.g., swapping leather for denim)
Width of the blue framing bars
mustRedesign: Do not replicate the exact faces of the original subjects
Ensure text is generic or user-defined
postGenerationChecks: Check for 4 distinct figures in the composition
Ensure the slab serif font is sufficiently heavy
Confirm the red border is present and unbroken
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + dark background + thin red border + [Blue Bar + Slab Serif Text] framing.
